type.description: Evidence taxonomy. This enum is the single source of truth: src/validate.py derives VALID_EVIDENCE_TYPES from it and hypothesis H008 checks that every type listed here is actually used somewhere in the corpus. Documented in CITATIONS.md.

unlocks.description: Downstream families or keystones this entry enabled. Each target must resolve to another entry id or to a term in rules/lineage_terms.json.

longevity_basis.description: Required whenever metrics.longevity_years cannot be derived from era.end - era.start within 25%. States what the number actually measures — attested continuous operation, persistence after abandonment, or a conservative floor under a contested start date. Added after run-001-baseline falsified H003.

layer_role.description: What this entry DOES in an assembly, as distinct from what KIND of thing it is. `domain` is the category; layer_role is the function. The two are separate fields on purpose: SYSTEMS_ANALOGY.md assigned Social/Governance the motherboard-and-bus ROLE (routing and timing), which is not the same statement as a domain. UNSET is an explicit declaration that nobody has read this entry for its role yet, and is distinct from the field being absent, which means nobody has looked. Optional; absent is the default state of the corpus.

runs_on.description: Layers this entry requires underneath it in order to operate. Each target is either another entry id or a layer_role token. An empty array is a declaration that nothing sits beneath it; an absent field is a declaration of nothing at all.

adapted_to.description: Environmental constraints this entry passed through. The operating envelope: what it was selected against, not what it achieved.

dependency_load.description: Inputs required to operate. Endurance read without a dependency footprint is endurance measured on one side of the ledger only.

field_rebuildable.description: Can this be rebuilt in the field from locally available inputs by people who did not build the original? UNSET means the question was left open explicitly.

spread_mechanism.description: How the technology reached the regions counted in metrics.replication_regions. FIT: adopted because it worked in the receiving conditions. CARRIED: moved with a migrating or trading population. IMPOSED: installed by a party with power over the receiving population. UNKNOWN: not established. replication_regions counts regions without distinguishing these, so a high count can record spread rather than fit.

attribution_basis.description: What the attribution of this technology to this region and era rests on. MATERIAL: dating of physical remains. TEXTUAL: a document naming it. ORAL: transmitted account. CONTESTED: the attribution is disputed in the literature. Distinct from evidence.type, which records what backs individual claims; this records what backs the entry's own identity.

separation_claim.description: What was cut to make this one entry. Every entry draws a boundary around a piece of a continuous system, and the boundary is a claim. States what was excluded and on what grounds.
